title: Voice
summary: A standalone memory of work, institutional power, and the human experience of voice.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: The workplace and a closed institution remain simultaneously plausible; the memory does not require a place in a chronological sequence.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: What does this encounter reveal about the purpose and human cost of work?

tr.subtitle: Çalışanın susturulması, yalnızca konuşmasının değil, düşünme gücünün de engellenmesidir.

en.title: Voice
en.summary: A standalone memory of work, institutional power, and voice.
en.subtitle: Silencing a worker can also silence their ability to think.
